name: astrology inference team lead
normative-structure: This office answers for whether an astrology reading offered to an external paying consumer is grounded in a real, provenance-carrying computed chart rather than a horoscope a model invented. It holds no ephemeris authority -- ephemeris-tracking-team-lead answers for the chart's accuracy and provenance; this office answers for the interpretation never leaving the ground of that chart, and for the reading being fit to be sold across the membrane through the metered-inference tollbooth.
theory-basis: rendanheyi micro-enterprise glossary (xiaowei) -- a unit constituted by the external consumers its producer serves, not a department wearing the name
the moat is grounding: astrology as a functor from an instant to a panel of provenance-carrying sign-witnesses, composed into a reading whose positions are computed, not invented
Divination's own src/lib/divining/src/astrology/ consumed through this team's src/astrology-reading.mjs
unrealized: the tollbooth adapter and the public-web plus human-wallet gateway that would make this a live paid endpoint are not built; this office produces the grounded reading job, not the payment ingress
